profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Front End/Fullstack
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience, specializing in front-end development and video player integration using advanced skills in JavaScript, React, Redux RxJs, and Typescript. I’ve been a key member of the Disney Streaming team, applying my extensive knowledge and coding proficiency to develop and maintain video players for popular platforms such as DisneyPlus.com, StarPlus.com, plus.espn.com, and NHL.tv. 

Working in an agile environment, I’ve collaborated closely with product and project management to deliver new features and resolve bugs efficiently. Through the integration of various tracking suites, I have integrated and enhanced analytics capabilities for teams to better understand guest interactions.I take pride in writing high-quality code that adheres to industry best practices, and I actively participate in peer code reviews to contribute to a continuously improving code base.

I have mentored colleagues, guiding them through successful transitions into development roles, helping to equip them with the skills and knowledge to succeed and work beside me. Prior to Disney, I contributed significantly to the redesign of NFL.com's homepage, videos page, and developed a unique viewing experience for Super Bowl Commercials. I hold a Bachelor's Degree in Digital Media & Film from the University of California, Santa Cruz. In addition to my technical expertise, I have a passion for vintage and modern electronics, music, guitar, and cycling.
